items.summary: StepFun has released Step 5 Preview as open weights with 600 billion total parameters, highlighting advancements in sparse Mixture-of-Experts models for complex tasks. This release is significant due to its large scale and potential impact on long-term artificial agency research.
items.summary_detailed: StepFun has released the open weights of their Step 5 Preview model, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts designed for long-term agency tasks, with 600 billion total parameters, 27 billion active per token, and capable of handling up to one million context tokens. The model is now available as FP8 and BF16 checkpoints on Hugging Face and ModelScope. This release could significantly impact the field of large language models by providing researchers and developers with a powerful tool for advanced applications.
items.summary_bullets:
• Step 5 Preview open weights released by StepFun
• FP8 and BF16 checkpoints available on Hugging Face and ModelScope
• 600B total parameters in the model
• 27B active parameters per token
• Up to 1M tokens of context supported
